queries_run: PLTR Palantir analyst consensus price target vs guidance Q3 2026 earnings
Palantir raises 2026 full-year guidance revenue outlook November 2026

findings.claim: Q3 2026 財報（2026-11-02）公司把全年營收 guidance 上調至 $8.530–8.534B，前次約 $8.15–8.16B（中點上調約 $378M）；Q4 營收 guidance $2.649–2.653B。
Q4 營收 guidance 約高於市場共識 8%；財報後盤後股價下跌約 3%。
findings.source: aiweekly.co: Palantir Q3 Revenue Nearly Doubles to $2.31B, Guides to $8.53B

findings.claim: 財報前（約 2026-10-30 收盤）分析師平均目標價約 $218.95，最高 $265（Barclays）；財報後 Mizuho 目標價 $205 維持 Hold、Jefferies $70 維持 Sell，目標價分布極寬。
findings.source: TIKR / TipRanks（Mizuho stays cautious…; Barclays $265 target）

findings.claim: Palantir 上調 2026 營收展望至約 $85 億，Q3 優於預期
findings.excerpt: beats Q3 estimates, lifts 2026 revenue outlook to around $8.5 billion Stocks Eamonn Sheridan 02/11/2026 | 21:15 GMT, published 02/11/2026 at 09:15 PM Tags Stock Earnings Summary Palantir beat Q3 forecasts with revenue of about $2.31bn and adjusted EPS of $0.44, then guided Q4 revenue to roughly $2.65bn, near 8% above the consensus, and lifted its full-year revenue outlook to about $8.53bn
